description:
Get a single verified asset by ID. Returns details including type, value, status, and verification timestamps.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_my_proof

channel.description: How the asset was verified: a verification channel, or `otp` / `magic_link` for an email address confirmed from the dashboard

has_proof.description: Whether a proof token is stored for this asset. Sent by the point read (`GET /me/assets/{id}`) only.

proof_expires_at.description: When the proof backing this asset expires

proof_id.description: Public handle of the proof backing this asset (`ph_ctl_<32 hex>`), or null when the asset predates the proof registry. This is the `control_proof` value `POST /api/v1/delegations` takes.

proof_status.description: Registry status of that proof. Only an `active` proof can anchor a delegation.

proof_token.description: The stored signed proof token. Returned by the point read (`GET /me/assets/{id}`) to a JWT owner session ONLY — an API-key caller and the list response carry `has_proof` alone.

type.description: Type of asset being verified. Not yet available — no channel of theirs can be completed, so a create or start answers 400 `channel_not_available`: social, wallet, account.
